what: News Corp owns newspapers and information businesses: The Wall Street Journal and Dow Jones, UK and Australian newspapers, the book publisher HarperCollins, and a majority of the property site REA Group.
customers: Subscribers to its publications and data services, advertisers, book buyers, and property searchers in Australia.
money: The Wall Street Journal, Barron's and professional information services
REA Group in Australia and Realtor.com
moat: Professional information subscriptions at Dow Jones that businesses expense rather than cancel, plus REA Group's dominant position in Australian property listings.
risks: Print newspaper revenue continues to decline
Realtor.com has lost ground to Zillow
Family control through dual-class shares limits minority influence
opportunities: Dow Jones professional information grows at double digits with very high margins
Selling or separating lower-growth assets would surface value
watch: Dow Jones professional information growth and REA Group's results.
